timestamp_derivation: After the configuration UX redesign, the scope verification and the full UI suite passed; before the author timestamp of the commit that introduces this receipt. Per T0091, in the order T0108 requires.

configuration_ux.before: The connection screen always showed a table of every saved version, each labelled by the endpoint -- the one field that never changed -- so three different versions read as three identical rows.
configuration_ux.after: Current configuration is the whole normal view. Previous versions are behind a History action. Operator-facing language is Version, Current configuration, Previous and History; Revision remains the internal term in code, API and database.
configuration_ux.difference_shown: Each previous version states what changed from the one before it, computed from stored values only. Identical connection settings are reported as identical, with the internal difference named.

provenance.not_stored_in_revisions: pms_interface_revisions holds no timestamp, author or reason -- only the configuration.
provenance.stored_in_audit_log: public.audit_log records pms_interface_revision.authored and pms_interface.revision_published with ts, actor_id and a reason_code. History reads those and nothing else.
provenance.absent_is_stated: A version with no audit entry is shown as origin-not-recorded. Nothing is inferred.
